name: 2N4125
description: PNP general-purpose amplifier, complement to the NPN 2N4124. Higher ft (200MHz) makes it useful in small-signal and moderate-speed switching. TO-92 pinout is E-B-C (base center). Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right (base center). Fairchild draws the package mirrored but the base stays center; identify the collector by the tab side, not the drawing viewpoint.

typical_application: General-purpose PNP small-signal amplification and moderate-speed switching; complement to 2N4124 in low-voltage complementary stages.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C (base center), the American convention
Vebo is only -4V; keep reverse base-emitter voltage low
low-voltage part (Vceo -30V); not for high-voltage use
